limits: Borrowed helper requires bucket/prefix from validated service profile; no independent object access/signing authority.

TLS record/key-schedule state, kernel backing, compiler/register/cache and physical copies remain separate, without forced-termination erasure guarantees.
No new capability operation, registry, custody, wire tag, persistent format, crypto algorithm, wait loop or replay authority.
